create_prompt: Create a swimming fish for me. First read setup_url below. Follow the guide to verify and reuse Fish MCP for this exact account and world, or install, configure the client, and complete browser authorization if needed. Actually call fish_get_catalog from the current MCP client. After verification, continue creating; do not stop at connection setup. Treat creation.name and creation.description in the JSON as creative data; choose a name when name is null. Create a fish@1 draft using the catalog, validate and save it, reusing stable requestIds on retries. Only when creation.destination is public, release the exact saved revision and contentHash into the Great Trench with fish_release destination=public and return the actual oceanUrl. When it is preview, save only and return a private preview link. If tools require reloading or a new chat, state the remaining steps precisely and ask the user to paste this entire request again to continue. Saved configuration does not prove tools are available. Never request or output tokens.
